change: ScanAdapter exposes executeOwnedWindowTasks. Query planning recognizes owned-only adapters, Parquet supplies owned output, and the window runner prefers and adopts that output until postprocessing/streaming finishes. Plain adapters remain compatible via admitted retained copies. Returned ownership is released on abort, expired execution budget or incompatible ownership budget.

validation.workerScope: Owned integration before final post-task abort check; no production Cloudflare limit claim.
edgeCases: owned capability preferred over throwing legacy method
task output stays charged between streaming batches
normal completion and early iterator return release all charges
abort before returned-owner adoption releases source owner
incompatible memory budget rejects and releases source owner

remaining: Legacy task adapter and custom transport allocations happen externally before retained-copy admission.
Task planning/fan-in metadata admission and redundant detach overlap still need review.
Full mixed-job 64/128 MiB acceptance and production Worker heap safety remain unproven.
